title: Sahyadri Foods independent directors denied audit access, ₹420 crore in related-party transactions flagged
summary: A Mint investigation reports systemic governance failures at Sahyadri Foods Ltd, where independent directors say they were repeatedly denied access to audit reports flagging related-party transactions worth over ₹420 crore. Three directors have resigned in four months and SEBI has reportedly issued show-cause notices to the company and four promoters.

sentiment.rationale: Loaded language including 'systemic governance failures', 'denied access', and 'operating blind' frames Sahyadri unfavorably. Director quotes and SEBI action both reinforce the negative framing.

key_claims.claim: Independent directors at Sahyadri Foods say they were repeatedly denied access to internal audit reports.
The flagged related-party transactions were worth over ₹420 crore.
Three directors have resigned in the past four months.
SEBI has reportedly issued show-cause notices to the company and four promoters.
Sahyadri Foods has not publicly commented on the specific allegations.
